restore_python:
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,base64,tarfile,io
for folder,item in json.loads(Path('evd-043.json').read_bytes())['archives'].items():
    obj=json.loads(Path(item['file']).read_bytes())
    data=base64.b64decode(obj['data'],validate=True)
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==item['sha256']==obj['sha256']
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data),mode='r:gz') as t:
        ledger=json.load(t.extractfile('archive-file-digests.json'))
        for name,expected in ledger.items():
            path=Path(folder)/name
            assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(Path(folder).resolve())
            b=t.extractfile(name).read()
            assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==expected
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(b)
